purpose: A divided action bar pinned below a DropdownMenu's list, with status text and buttons such as Clear and Apply. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a DropdownMenu.
The action bar of a Popover.
The action bar of a Modal.

Default.visual: A Border/subtle rule on top; leading text in Content/secondary; inline puts the text first and buttons at the end, stacked gives full-width buttons.

a11y.keyboard: Outside the menu role: its buttons are reached with Tab after the list.
